decisions.reason: The mobile-phone framing request changes the hero product visual, but it does not alter the landing page's clean, minimal SaaS aesthetic, brand-asset usage, or Loom style reference.
The source changes presentation of the hero photo and does not change the hero headline or other copy.
The source explicitly targets the top hero photo, not the separate founder image at the bottom of the landing page.
Displaying the existing hero visual within a mobile-phone frame does not necessarily change the page's content types, image quantity, or screenshot selection policy.
